{{Quote|We receive no pleasure from this trial, but we act as fate demands. Be strong, Outlander.|Berusal|<ref name="Chapter 8" />}}
'''Berusal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Chapter 6" /> from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]]<ref name="Homeworld" /> who was a member of the [[Scions of Zakuul]], a subgroup of the [[Knights of Zakuul]] that specialized in [[Force vision/Legends|Force visions]] and were obsessed with the idea of fate. A fair-skinned man with blond [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Berusal wielded a magenta-colored [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in battle like other Scions. After [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Arcann]] ordered the massacre of the Scions around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of his ascension to the throne of the [[Eternal Empire]], Berusal was among the few Scions who escaped the purge and settled in an enclave on the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] [[Asylum]] under the leadership of [[Heskal]].<ref name="Chapter 6" /> In [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the Scions summoned the figure known as [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]] to Asylum and tested the foreigner to determine why they could not see the Outlander's future. Along with other Scions, Berusal attacked the Outlander in a series of combat tests that ultimately revealed the presence of [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]], the Immortal Emperor, within the Outlander's mind. The Scions promised their loyalty to the Outlander, but Heskal later betrayed the Scions and the Outlander to Arcann and drew him to Asylum, as his visions led him to believe it was necessary to force a confrontation. Arcann massacred Berusal and the other Scions just before the Outlander's arrival, sparking the [[Battle of Asylum]].<ref name="Chapter 8" />

==Behind the scenes==
Berusal appears in Chapter VI: Asylum in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], a [[2015]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Chapter 6" /> He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].
